description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDao class, which manages database operations related to employee memberships, such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee membership records within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for CRUD and search operations on EmployeeMembership entities in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeMembership record by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeMembershipIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing employee membership IDs for a given employee number from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeMembership records for a specified employee and IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Performs a search for employee memberships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for employee membership search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee membership records matching the search filter criteria.
